# Raw Write/Read/List — verify raw file operations

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# --- Write a raw file ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write test.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/test.csv'

# --- Verify file exists on disk ---
exists raw/test.csv

# --- Read the raw file back ---
exec akb raw read test.csv
stdout 'hello'

# --- Read with raw/ prefix ---
exec akb raw read raw/test.csv
stdout 'hello'

# --- List raw files ---
exec akb raw list
stdout 'test.csv'

# --- Write a raw file in a subdirectory ---
stdin ../logo-input.txt
exec akb raw write images/logo.png
stdout 'Written to raw/images/logo.png'

# --- Verify subdirectory was created ---
exists raw/images/logo.png

# --- List includes subdirectory file ---
exec akb raw list
stdout 'images/logo.png'
stdout 'test.csv'

# --- files.log is excluded from list ---
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'files.log'

# --- Block writing files.log ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
! exec akb raw write files.log
stderr 'managed file'

# --- Block kb/ prefix on raw write ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
! exec akb raw write kb/test.md
stderr 'akb write'

# --- Block raw/ prefix on regular write ---
stdin ../note-input.md
! exec akb write raw/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# --- Block pipe character in filename ---
stdin ../pipe-input.txt
! exec akb raw write "data|with|pipes.txt"
stderr 'must not contain'

# --- Block .. in path ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
! exec akb raw write ../etc/passwd
stderr 'must not contain'

# --- Block absolute path ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
! exec akb raw write /tmp/evil.txt
stderr 'must be relative'

# --- Read nonexistent file ---
! exec akb raw read nonexistent.csv
stderr 'raw file not found'

# --- Block kb/ prefix on raw read ---
! exec akb raw read kb/test.md
stderr 'akb read'

-- csv-input.txt --
hello

-- logo-input.txt --
data

-- pipe-input.txt --
data

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Raw Write Guard Note
summary: Note for the raw/ prefix guard check
tags: test
---
Guard note content.
